description: NameOps.hasSeparator(bytes) (src/utils/NameOps.sol#40-64) contains an incorrect shift operation: keep_hasSeparator_asm_0 = ~ 1 << 0x20 - rem_hasSeparator_asm_0 << 3 - 1 (src/utils/NameOps.sol#51)
reason: False positive. Yul shl(shift, value) takes the shift amount first, so not(sub(shl(shl(3, sub(0x20, rem)), 1), 1)) keeps the first `rem` bytes of the word. Covered by NameOps.t.sol, NameOpsTail.t.sol and the golden vectors.

description:
Reentrancy in ChunkStore.write(address,bytes,bytes32,uint48) (src/ChunkStore.sol#32-50):
	External calls:
	- pointer = IStorageBackend(backend).store(input,msg.sender) (src/ChunkStore.sol#39)
	Event emitted after the call(s):
	- ChunkWritten(id,backend,pointer,inputHash,dataHash,size) (src/ChunkStore.sol#49)
reason: By design; same call as the reentrancy-no-eth entry. ChunkWritten is emitted only for the record this call writes.

description:
Reentrancy in ChunkStore.write(address,bytes,bytes32,uint48) (src/ChunkStore.sol#32-50):
	External calls:
	- pointer = IStorageBackend(backend).store(input,msg.sender) (src/ChunkStore.sol#39)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- _records[id] = Record({backend:backend,size:size,pointer:pointer,dataHash:dataHash}) (src/ChunkStore.sol#48)
	ChunkStore._records (src/ChunkStore.sol#29) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- ChunkStore._record(bytes32) (src/ChunkStore.sol#115-118)
	- ChunkStore.exists(bytes32) (src/ChunkStore.sol#96-98)
	- ChunkStore.read(bytes32) (src/ChunkStore.sol#58-93)
	- ChunkStore.write(address,bytes,bytes32,uint48) (src/ChunkStore.sol#32-50)
reason: By design. write() calls the backend the writer chose. The id commits to that backend's address, so a re-entering backend can only create records under its own address. A record set during the call stands (checked again after it), and a readable backend's result is checked against dataHash and size before the record is written. Covered by the re-entrant backend mock in ChunkStore.t.sol.
